notes.title: Final Early Access Update
notes.content:

notes.title: Early Access Update - v1.7-ea is now live
notes.content:
Code Cleanup / Refactor

Changed power-up effects in order to their scale represent the exact parameter of "Radius"

Effects / Animations

Added pause menu countdown effect
Improved LAST STAND so that its ease (slow down and speed up curve) perfectly match the Bézier curve of its animation
Fixed an issue related to the fire effects on memorythm_08 which caused heavy stuttering and FPS drops

Gameplay

Tweaked LAST STAND to automatically trigger a Power Shield as well, along with a Regeneration and a Sonic Boom

Maps

Added physical objects to memorythm_15

Optimizations

Optimized various parts of the game which reduced the installer by 500MB

QoL improvements

Improved pause menu with countdown upon clicking continue

UI

Changed text of countdown animation

SFX

Added SFX to countdown animation


If you have any issues or questions, please contact us on the Bass Defense Discord Server or via any platforms below.

notes.title: Early Access Update - v1.5-ea is now live
notes.content:
Effects / Animations

Added press [SPACE] icon to highlight when Players can activate the given power-up and to improve the overall rate of power-up usage
Tweaked HP feedback colors to help differentiate low (70%) HP

Help / Tooltips

Added How to Play screen to Main Menu UI and Game Over UI
Added tooltips to Power-Up UI

Optimizations

Changed level order (memorythm_02  memorythm_05) to optimize the learning curve of the game

QoL improvements

Improved HP feedback by aligning that to the center of the base

SFX

Added SFX to base damage

UI

Added energy capsules earned quantity to Score Screen UI


If you have any issues or questions, please contact us on the Bass Defense Discord Server or via any platforms below.
